assumptions.statement: Statutory land-use, FAR, height, setback, density and facility controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: All intensity and massing statements are design guidance and require official control confirmation.

assumptions.statement: SITE-001 and PROV-KEY-001..003 are maintainer-provided provisional frames, not surveyed official polygons.
assumptions.impact: All area-derived outputs and layouts must be regenerated after official geometry is issued.

assumptions.statement: Authoritative parcels, ownership, existing buildings and business occupancy data are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Retain-renovate-add actions are prototype strategies, not demolition or acquisition decisions.

assumptions.statement: Building age, structure, fire safety, heritage status and lawful floor area have not been surveyed.
assumptions.impact: No building intervention proceeds before structural, fire, heritage and ownership due diligence.

assumptions.statement: Road redlines, traffic counts, station entrances, bridge clearances and parking inventories are not authoritative.
assumptions.impact: MAIN-IF and gateways describe desired connections; alignments and sections require transport approval.

assumptions.statement: River blue lines, flood levels, soil, canopy and drainage capacity are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Sponge and ecological features are spatial reservations pending water and landscape engineering.

assumptions.statement: Operators, budgets, service demand and performance baselines are not yet contracted or observed.
assumptions.impact: Uptime, response time and participation values are pilot targets and must be reset from measured baselines.

assumptions.statement: Railway heritage inventory, protection areas and construction-control zones are unavailable as cleared GIS.
assumptions.impact: Cultural markers use reversible installations and avoid fabric claims until heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Power, telecom, drainage, heating, waste and edge-compute capacities are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Infrastructure components are reservations, not engineering capacity commitments.

assumptions.statement: Funding, procurement, land coordination and approval routes have not been assigned by government.
assumptions.impact: Project sponsors in the proposal are recommended accountable roles, not confirmed commitments.

projection_note: Gate D retains unresolved Gate A assumptions and adds no evidence.
